periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downwards toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically oriented ovals with an approximate 1.5:1 height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the inferior margin extending further from the geometric center than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shaped profile with minimal posterior extension along the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, covering roughly one-third of the visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral placement with an inter-ear gap roughly equivalent to 1.5 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly continuous and rounded apex with a smooth semicircular profile.
